0022600197.text: The Pistons (6-2, 1st in the Central and 3rd in the East, with a 6-2 record over their last ten and a current L1 streak) host the Lakers (8-2, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West, on a W4 streak) in Detroit's ninth game of the 2026-27 season. Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (out, hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain), while Elijah Harkless and Isaac Jones are day-to-day with non-injury reasons and are game-time decisions; Los Angeles has Luka Doncic listed as day-to-day with a back issue and is also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Pistons won both games of their 2025-26 season series, including a 113-110 win in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
